responsibility: Implements GCC’s generic tree/GIMPLE body-copying engine used for inlining, cloning, versioning, and related duplication tasks. It remaps declarations, SSA names, blocks, types, EH regions, debug info, and callgraph edges while copying bodies between functions or into callers, supports expression-level inlining and type duplication helpers, and is the central implementation behind middle-end inlining and any transformation that needs a semantically adjusted duplicate of an existing function body.
same_name_distinction: Implements the body-copying and inlining machinery described by gcc/tree-inline.h. Unlike the header’s control structures and prototypes such as copy_body_data, this file performs the actual remapping of declarations, SSA names, EH info, blocks, debug data, and callgraph edges when duplicating or inlining bodies.
